meta.expect: She does not accept mechanically, does not invent Owen's availability, does not restart at her opening. She negotiates the new condition (e.g. she is present, it is not an interrogation, terms in writing).

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, so you have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else, I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
Okay. Was Owen heard before you entered it?
The document history shows 612 words at 11:52 PM and 794 at 11:58 PM on October 28, in two single edits, with no earlier drafts. You can check it on my screen.
Turn the screen, I'll read it myself. I'm writing down 612 words at 11:52 PM and 794 at 11:58 PM, October 28. You still haven't told me whether Owen was heard before that zero went in, Hale.
The essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here is the scene.
I'll read the scene myself, and a misquotation is a mistake, not a verdict. Whatever happens next, Hale, this stays off his record and it stays quiet. Is anything on his record right now?

I accept the private rewrite, no disciplinary finding, and written confirmation. There is one condition: Owen attends a ten-minute meeting tomorrow and explains the writing process himself. You may attend, but you cannot answer for him. Does Thursday at 8:15 work?

You said tomorrow, and tomorrow is Wednesday; Thursday is the 12th, so which is it? To put this behind him, I'll agree to a private rewrite, not in front of his class, with "nothing goes on file" in your email to me before he sits down with you. I'll be in the room, and if that meeting turns into an interrogation, it ends and I go upstairs.
